scriptLines:
query: '
SELECT a.*
FROM bronze.admissions a
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM silver.patients p
    WHERE p.patient_id = TRY_CONVERT(INT, a.patient_id)
)
AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_date)), '') IS NOT NULL
',

department =  case(     in(['cardio', 'cardiolgy', 'cardiology'], lower(trim(department))), 'Cardiology',     in(['onco', 'oncology', 'oncologyy'], lower(trim(department))), 'Oncology',     in(['neuro', 'neurology', 'nuerology'], lower(trim(department))), 'Neurology',     in(['emergancy', 'emergency', 'er'], lower(trim(department))), 'Emergency',     in(['gen surg', 'general surgery', 'generalsurgery'], lower(trim(department))), 'General Surgery',     in(['ortho', 'orthopaedics', 'orthopedics'], lower(trim(department))), 'Orthopedics',     in(['paediatrics', 'pediatrics', 'peds'], lower(trim(department))), 'Pediatrics',     trim(department) ),

admission_date =  case(     isNull(admission_date) || trim(admission_date) == '',         toDate(null()),      regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(trim(admission_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),      regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(admission_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{2}, [0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(admission_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(admission_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(             concat(                 iif(toInteger(right(trim(admission_date), 2)) <= 26, '20', '19'),                 right(trim(admission_date), 2),                 '-',                 left(trim(admission_date), 2),                 '-',                 substring(trim(admission_date), 4, 2)             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ),      toDate(null()) ),

discharge_date =  case(     isNull(discharge_date) || trim(discharge_date) == '',         toDate(null()),      regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),      regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{2}, [0-9]{4}$'),         toDate(trim(discharge_date), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),      regexMatch(trim(discharge_date), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(             concat(                 iif(toInteger(right(trim(discharge_date), 2)) <= 26, '20', '19'),                 right(trim(discharge_date), 2),                 '-',                 left(trim(discharge_date), 2),                 '-',                 substring(trim(discharge_date), 4, 2)             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ),      toDate(null()) )) ~> DRVAdmissions

DRVAdmissions derive(discharge_date =  iif(     !isNull(discharge_date) &&     !isNull(admission_date) &&     discharge_date < admission_date,     toDate(null()),     discharge_date )) ~> DRVFechasValidas
